jro_se11: Lucien "Shadow" Jro arrived on Day 3 as a replacement. The men in R-F18 had been fighting for 2 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Lucien "Shadow" Jro was named Hero of Verdel Ridge. Asked for a few words, he gave the names of the people who had helped.
Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Lucien "Shadow" Jro accepted it as a review.
Lucien "Shadow" Jro obtained a recipe for a steamed suet pudding. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks.
rboir6: On Day 4 Rafael Rboir took a post at S-F4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters, and the men liked him for it.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Rafael Rboir and Teodor Roos exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
somosmagios.bo: Nobody asked Edmund Somosmagios why he came. Nobody in S-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Edmund Somosmagios was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Edmund Somosmagios and Anselm Tom compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Edmund Somosmagios watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A single shot from across the wire hit Edmund Somosmagios in the thigh at S-F9. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Isidor Jackmdunn of the Concord (@jackmdunn06).
Edmund Somosmagios drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
